classes.name: IncludeNode
classes.description: Represents an include node in the Twig AST, responsible for rendering included templates with optional variables and handling missing templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the IncludeNode with an expression to include, optional variables, flags for 'only' and 'ignore missing', and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to compile the include node, handling template loading, optional ignoring of missing templates, and passing variables.

methods.name: addGetTemplate
methods.description: Adds PHP code to load and retrieve the template specified in the include node.

methods.name: addTemplateArguments
methods.description: Adds code to pass variables to the included template, considering 'only' flag and context merging.
